Byte-exact check: MD5 of a real game.states minus its last 16 bytes equals those 16 bytes.

cells.0x20000000: float scalar (second = IEEE-754 bits); counted variants are NOT implemented
cells.0x00000000: int scalar; also used for integer dict keys
cells.0x50000000: StrData (inline string bytes in typed payload)

locked_card_cursor.evidence: CApplication::ResetVariables resets CSettings variables variable_mainmenu_selectedoption (0x5b7ce8) and variable_playmenu_selectedoption (0x5b7d0c); the dock/UI keeps its own cursor. No per-card locked-cursor value is serialized by CSettings/CUnlocker. A locked card's availability comes from CUnlocker flags/unlock lists, so persisting progress via CUnlocker is the prerequisite for restoring any cursor state.
